name: Advanced Notifications
description: Browser web-push notifications plus an in-site notification bell inbox, with campaign scheduling, role targeting, and delivery reporting.
library_dependencies: minishlink/web-push ^9.0 (PHP library, required — performs the actual VAPID-signed Web Push delivery)
project_description: Advanced Notifications adds browser push notifications and an in-site notification bell inbox to Drupal. Site administrators create, schedule, send, and review notification campaigns without building a custom notification system. It defines a Subscription content entity (web_push_subscription) populated from the browser Push API through a REST resource, and a Campaign content entity (web_push_campaign) holding each notification's title, body, link, icon, image, target roles, delivery mode (browser push, notification bell, or both), status and schedule. A cron-driven queue delivers scheduled campaigns; the minishlink/web-push library sends VAPID-signed pushes to each subscription's endpoint. A placeable notification-bell block gives logged-in users an inbox (unread count, list, dismiss, clear-all) backed by per-user user.data, and a subscription block lets visitors opt in or out. Configuration covers default push options (TTL, urgency, topic, batch size, prompt behaviour), VAPID key generation, flood control, and a delivery report. Requires core REST, Serialization and User, PHP 8.1 with mbstring/curl/openssl, and HTTPS for the browser Push API.
